name: Vampire of the Deep (CR 11)
body:
VAMPIRE OF THE DEEP
CR 11

XP 12,800
Human vampire of the deep fighter 3/necromancer 7
CE Medium undead (aquatic, augmented human)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +11

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 13, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +6 natural, +1 dodge)
hp 80 (3d10+6 plus 7d6+14 plus 7); fast healing 5
Fort +7, Ref +7, Will +7; +8 vs. fear
Defensive Abilities bravery +1, channel resistance +4; DR 10/magic, 10/silver; Immune undead traits; Resist cold 10, electricity 10; Weaknesses aquatic vampire weaknesses

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., swim 30 ft.
Melee slam +10 (1d4+6 plus energy drain)
Special Attacks blood drain, children of the deep (1/day), create spawn, dominate (DC 17), energy drain (2 levels) (DC 17), turn undead (4/day, DC 15)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; melee touch +10):

4/day—grave touch

Spells Prepared (CL 7th; melee touch +10, ranged touch +8): None currently prepared, due to prolonged confinement
Arcane School necromancy; Opposition Schools enchantment, illusion

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 14, Con —, Int 13, Wis 12, Cha 14
Base Atk +6; CMB +10; CMD 23
Feats Alertness, Combat Reflexes, Craft Wondrous Item, Dodge, Extend Spell, Greater Spell Penetration, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Lunge, Mobility, Scribe Scroll, Skill Focus (Knowledge [arcana]), Spell Penetration, Still Spell, Toughness, Turn Undead, Weapon Focus (rapier)
Skills Bluff +10, Knowledge (arcana) +15, Knowledge (geography) +10, Knowledge (local) +11, Knowledge (nature) +12, Linguistics +8, Perception +11, Profession (sailor) +14, Sense Motive +15, Spellcraft +16, Stealth +10, Swim +25
Languages Abyssal, Aquan, Common, Sylvan
SQ change shape (lamprey swarm or shark, beast shape II), gaseous form (at will, appears as sea foam or bubbles), shadowless, spider climb

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Change Shape (Su)

A vampire of the deep can use change shape to assume the form of a leech swarm or a large shark, as beast shape II.

Children of the Deep (Su)

Once per day, a vampire of the deep can call forth 1d6+1 leech swarms, 1d4+1 gulper eels, or 2d6 medium barracuda as a standard action. These creatures arrive in 2d6 rounds and serve for up to 1 hour.

Create Spawn (Su)

A vampire of the deep can create spawn out of those he slays with blood drain or energy drain, provided that the slain creature is of the same creature type as the vampire of the deep (humanoid). The victim rises from death as an aquatic vampire in 1d4 days. This vampire is under the vampire of the deep’s command, and remains enslaved until it’s destruction.

A vampire of the deep may have enslaved spawn totaling no more than twice his own Hit Dice; any spawn he creates that would exceed this limit become free-willed undead. A vampire of the deep may free an enslaved spawn in order to enslave a new spawn, but once freed, a vampire or vampire spawn cannot be enslaved again.

Dominate (Su)

A vampire of the deep can crush a humanoid opponent’s will as a standard action. Anyone he targets must succeed on a Will save or fall instantly under his influence, as though by a dominate person spell (CL 12th). The ability has a range of 30 feet.

Energy Drain (Su)

A creature hit by a vampire of the deep’s slam (or other natural weapons in animal form) gains two negative levels.

This ability only triggers once per round, regardless of the number of attacks a it makes.

Gaseous Form (Su)

As a standard action, a vampire of the deep can assume gaseous form at will (CL 5th), but can remain gaseous indefinitely and has a fly speed of 20 feet with perfect maneuverability. It appears as a frothing sea foam if near the surface, but appears as hundreds of tiny bubbles when lurking in the deeps.

Spider Climb (Ex)

A vampire of the deep can climb sheer surfaces as though under the effects of a spider climb spell.

Aquatic Vampire Weaknesses

Vampires cannot tolerate the touch of pure salt and will not enter an area laced with it. Similarly, they recoil from mirrors, reflective surfaces or strongly presented holy symbols. These things don’t harm the vampire—they merely keep it at bay. A recoiling vampire must stay at least 5 feet away from the object or holy symbol and cannot touch or make melee attacks against that creature. Holding a vampire at bay takes a standard action. After 1 round, a vampire can overcome its revulsion of the object and function normally each round it makes a DC 25 Will save.

Reducing an aquatic vampire’s hit points to 0 or lower incapacitates it but doesn’t always destroy it (see fast healing). However, certain attacks can slay vampires.

Exposing any vampire to direct sunlight staggers it on the first round of exposure and destroys it utterly on the second consecutive round of exposure if it does not escape. Each round the aquatic vampire is not submerged in water inflicts damage equal to one-third of its maximum hit points—an aquatic vampire reduced to 0 hit points in this manner is destroyed. Driving a coral shard through a helpless vampire’s heart instantly slays it (this is a full-round action). However, it returns to life if the shard is removed, unless the head is also severed and anointed with holy water (difficult underwater).
